design.input: Same verified picture and decoded sound clock as the prior 26-source comparison. All groups are already exposed.
design.comparison: Current two-band audio calls and adjacent local-band audio calls, each with the same mouth measurement. This compares nominations, independently of the incumbent app's previously recorded timing result.
design.new_controls: Move the corresponding mouth crops and sound together in both directions. Add the same independent speech-band bed under each of two adjacent segments of ordinary audio.
design.truth: Both witnesses reach 0.50 temporal IoU. The first or second range may contain the reused samples. The match cannot determine which changed, or the full edit interval.
design.rule: At least four added useful pairs across at least three held groups, both banks represented, no lost useful pairs, at most two additional ordinary flags and zero synchronized or global flags.
